validation_rules.message: clip-play-caption needs a supplied video clip on the scene
clip-play-caption needs overlay text (the caption) on the scene
the caption fade-in cannot be longer than the scene

title: Play a supplied clip with a caption
purpose: Plays the supplied video clip unchanged (approved source start point, normal speed, the scene's duration) with the scene's overlay text shown exactly as approved as a caption near the bottom. No audio is produced; a clip with sound is rendered only when the plan explicitly says to drop it (source_audio drop).
intents: video with a line of text
